title: Jonathan
summary: Son of Saul, killed with his father (1 Sam 31). Jones dates that death.
description: Son of Saul. Not Jonathan Goforth. Jones, Appendix F, dates his death on the same row as Saul’s death. No birth year is printed, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament) prints this BC/AD year on the death entry (2948 1056 Death of Saul and Jonathan). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

death.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
death.note: This row dates Jonathan’s death. The same words also date Saul’s death, entered on saul.
